author: bardic-inspiration
name: Tangle Seed
summary: A seed that sprouts into a knot of vines when thrown.
description: Found in the gardens of the wild courts. It wriggles in the palm.

stats.effect: As a Magic action, you can throw this seed at a point within 30 feet. Vines burst out in a 10-foot radius; each creature in the area makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw or has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition for 1 minute. A restrained creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. The seed is consumed.
